originalAlarm.description: Assigned value is garbage or undefined

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: The alarm fires at line 8 (conv[0]=(xx>=0)?'+':'-') saying the assigned value is garbage or undefined. This is because on line 7, 'int16_t xx = x*10' can overflow for large float values (int16_t max is 32767, so values of x > ~3276.7 cause signed integer overflow, which is undefined behavior in C). The subsequent use of the undefined xx on line 8 makes the assigned value garbage. KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for 31873ec707d.c documents exactly this IntegerOverflow bug (int16_t overflow at line 7 when ULTRA_LCD is enabled). The tool is detecting the same underlying bug from the propagated undefined value perspective.
